name: After § 27
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 27a. Recalls the Ombudsman’s conclusions regarding the Commission’s refusal to disclose key documents and communications relating to the EU’s vaccine contracts; points out that the Court of Justice of the European Union has also condemned this lack of transparency by the Commission1a; stresses that the Ombudsman’s repeated warnings must be followed by binding and enforceable measures to ensure full accountability in all future contracts of strategic importance; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Judgment of the General Court of 14 May 2025, Stevi and The New York Times v Commission, Case T-36/23, ECLI:EU:T:2025:483.
